chapters.label: The free kick, live
chapters.text: Sochi, 2018. Germany and Sweden are level, and time is almost up. A free kick, wide on the left. Toni Kroos taps it to Marco Reus, Reus stops it... and Kroos curls it... Goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch it again, from behind. The little pass opens the angle. It rises over everyone, swings wide, and bends back in.

chapters.label: From behind the goal
chapters.text: From behind the goal: the keeper flies, too late! Top corner!

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: The secret? A tight angle? Pass it short to open it up. Then curl it, up and over, into the far corner.
